Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. 

Your Role

  • Design and build scalable, reliable backend and platform systems optimized for ML workloads, ensuring high availability and performance
  • Enforce strong engineering practices including modular design, automated testing, code quality, and scalability standards
  • Develop and manage cloud-native infrastructure with Kubernetes, containers, and microservices, while optimizing for cost and resilience
  • Establish and scale CI/CD pipelines across both application and ML lifecycles, with full observability (logging, metrics, tracing)
  • Architect and implement end-to-end MLOps pipelines, from data ingestion through deployment, monitoring, and automated retraining
  • Drive automation in model lifecycle management including versioning, experiment tracking, reproducibility, and governance using tools like MLflow, Kubeflow, and Airflow
  • Define, monitor, and continuously improve model performance using key metrics (accuracy, latency, drift, bias), with robust evaluation and A/B testing frameworks
  • Lead cross-functional teams and collaborate with stakeholders to deliver scalable AI solutions while shaping the ML platform strategy and adoption roadmap

Your Skills

  • Strong foundation in Software Engineering (Java/Python/Go) and system design
  • Expertise in DevOps practices (CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code)
  • Proven experience in MLOps frameworks and model lifecycle management
  • Deep understanding of model accuracy, evaluation metrics, and monitoring strategies
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (GCP/AWS/Azure)
  • Prior experience managing engineering teams

Why you will love working at Capgemini

  • At the heart of our mission is your career growth. Our array of career growth programs and diverse professions are crafted to support you in exploring a world of opportunities.
  • We recognize the significance of flexible work arrangements to provide support. Be it remote work, or flexible work hours, you will get an environment to maintain a healthy work life balance.

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

  • Act as a subject matter expert and provide functional/technical consultation during deployments
  • Identify, escalate, and resolve critical issues, including discrepancies between global and local requirements
  • Support technical decision-making and contribute to solution design and implementation specifications
  • Prioritize workload effectively while operating in a matrix environment
  • Demonstrate strong analytical and conceptual thinking to solve complex problems

Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. 

Your Role

  • Lead end-to-end SAP PP implementations, rollouts, and support engagements.
  • Drive business requirement gathering, solution design, and SAP PP configuration (MRP, BOM, routing, production orders).
  • Manage cross-functional integration with MM, SD, QM, and PM modulesLead testing cycles (SIT/UAT), deployments, and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Mentor team members and act as the key stakeholder interface for PP processes

Your Profile

  • 9+ years of experience in SAP PP with strong expertise in production planning and manufacturing processes.
  • Proven track record of leading full-cycle SAP implementations and handling client-facing roles.
  • Hands-on experience in SAP S/4HANA PP and integration with other modules.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent communication and leadership abilities with experience managing teams.

What you'll love about working here

  • You can shape your career with us. We offer a range of career paths and internal opportunities within Capgemini group.
  • You will also get personalized career guidance from our leaders.
  • You will get comprehensive wellness benefits including health checks, telemedicine, insurance with top-ups, elder care, partner coverage or new parent support via flexible work.
  • At Capgemini, you can work on cutting-edge projects in tech and engineering with industry leaders or create solutions to overcome societal and environmental challenges.

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

Your Role

  • Lead and deliver end‑to‑end implementations of SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central—from requirement gathering and planning to configuration, testing, and go‑live.
  • Configure MDF objects, Foundation Objects, business rules, workflows, data models, picklists, RBP, and instance sync activities.
  • Manage testing cycles including scenario creation, script execution, defect tracking, and cutover planning.
  • Collaborate with clients and functional teams to define solution design using the Configuration Workbook and ensure alignment with business processes.
  • Work across EC sub‑modules including Position Management, Global Assignments, Time‑Off, Timesheet, Reporting, and Benefits.
  • Ensure seamless EC integration with other SuccessFactors Talent modules and support post‑implementation activities.

Your Profile

  • 4–16 years of experience in SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central
  • Certified in SAP SF Employee Central with multiple end‑to‑end EC implementations.
  • Strong hands‑on experience in MDF, Foundation Objects, business rules, workflows, RBPs, picklists, and data models.
  • Expertise in Position Management, Global Assignment, Time‑Off, Timesheet, Reporting, and Benefits.
  • Deep understanding of EC integration with other SuccessFactors Talent modules and release management.
  • Skilled in client interaction, requirement analysis, testing, cutover, and solution documentation via Design/Config Workbooks.

data.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. 

Your Role

  • Design and build enterprise-grade services using SAP CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) with CDS and OData on SAP BTP Cloud Foundry.
  • Develop and maintain microservices/APIs using Node.js or Java, integrating with SAP HANA/HANA Cloud for data persistence and modelling.
  • Implement XSUAA-based security, JWT/OAuth2 authentication, and secure connectivity via Destinations and Connectivity services.
  • Optimize, test, and deploy applications; automate CI/CD and ensure robust logging via Audit Log on BTP.
  • Collaborate with UI teams on SAP UI5/Fiori integration (added advantage) and align solutions with best practices on BTP.

Your Profile

  • 4–10 years of experience in building cloud-native applications on SAP BTP using SAP CAP.
  • Strong hands-on with CAP, CDS, OData Services, and either Node.js or Java.
  • Experience with SAP HANA/HANA Cloud, Cloud Foundry, and XSUAA security configuration.
  • Solid understanding of BTP services (Destinations, Audit Log, Connectivity) and REST/JSON/JWT/OAuth2.
  • Familiarity with SAP UI5/Fiori development and end-to-end solution integration (nice to have).

What You’ll Love About Working Here

  • Opportunities to work with global clients on innovative SAP projects.
  • Dynamic and inclusive workplace culture.
  • Continuous learning and professional development support.

data.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

Your Role

  • Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks using Python and Robot Framework.
  • Perform ETL testing, including data validation, transformation checks, and end‑to‑end workflow verification.
  • Run and monitor scripts/jobs in Unix/Linux environments, ensuring smooth automation execution.
  • Support SQL automation for backend validation, data quality checks, and reporting accuracy.
  • Execute functional, regression, and data validation testing across complex data pipelines.
  • Apply strong knowledge of QE/QA processes and testing methodologies throughout the SDLC.
  • Work with CI/CD pipelines to automate test execution and deployment workflows.
  • Use DevOps tools such as Jenkins, Git, UCD, Helios, and GitHub Actions for automation, job management, and release coordination.

Your Profile

  • 4+ years of experience in Python development, automation, and data‑driven testing.
  • Proficiency in Python and Robot Framework for automation scripting.
  • Hands‑on expertise with ETL testing and data pipeline validation.
  • Strong experience working in Unix/Linux environments, including running and scheduling scripts.
  • Knowledge of data analysis, data processing, data management, and related BI concepts.
  • Familiarity with statistics, mathematics, and data science principles.
  • Solid understanding of QA/QE methodologies, automation strategy, and testing best practices.
  • Experience with CI/CD and DevOps tools: Jenkins, Git, UCD, Helios, GitHub Actions.
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Confluence, and qTest for project and test case management.

What You'll Love About Working With Us

  • Flexible remote and hybrid work options supporting healthy work‑life balance.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with industry standards.
  • Opportunities for career development, upskilling, and certifications across emerging technologies

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.

Make it real | www.capgemini.com/in-en.
